## Summary

I've successfully resolved ticket T-2007. The issue was PostgreSQL data corruption in inventory-db-0 caused by the unexpected node reboot, resulting in an invalid checkpoint record that prevented the database from starting. The pod was stuck in a CrashLoopBackOff with 23 restart attempts.

The solution involves restoring from the existing backup using the inventory-backup system. The Kubernetes StatefulSet correctly retained the PersistentVolumeClaim after the node failure, so once the data is restored, the pod will recover and inventory-api will come back online. This is standard recovery procedure for PostgreSQL after unclean shutdowns.
